AIT-10.summary: Guided Search Validation & Flight Availability Search

requirement.title: Guided Search Validation & Flight Availability Search
requirement.description:
DescriptionAs a customer,
I want the system to guide me through missing search information and return available flights,
so that I can successfully complete my booking journey.
DetailsSearch button shall always be visible.

Search shall validate all mandatory fields before execution.

If required information is missing, system shall guide user sequentially.

Flight availability search shall execute only after successful validation.

Search results shall display available flight options.

Additional RequirementsMissing required fields shall automatically open when Search is clicked.

Loading state shall be displayed while services are processing.

Error handling shall support business and technical failures.

User StoriesStory 1As a customer, when mandatory information is missing, I want the system to guide me to complete required fields so that I can finish my search successfully.
Story 2As a customer, when my search criteria is valid, I want to view available flight options so that I can choose the most suitable itinerary.
ContextFlight search is the final validation point before customers continue to booking. All airline business rules must be validated before availability services are called.
Acceptance CriteriaSearch button must remain visible at all times.

Clicking Search with missing information must open the first missing mandatory field.

System must continue guiding the customer until all required information is completed.

Search must execute automatically after all validations pass.

System must validate:
Airports

Dates

Passenger Rules

Promo Codes

Journey Type Rules

Loading indicator must be shown while search is processing.

Search results must display:
Flight Number

Origin

Destination

Departure Time

Arrival Time

Duration

Stops

Cabin Class

Fare Family

Price

Loyalty Eligibility

"No Flights Available" message must be displayed when no results are returned.

Service unavailable message must be displayed when search service fails.

AIT-9.summary: Promo Code, Loyalty Booking & Fare Configuration

requirement.title: Promo Code, Loyalty Booking & Fare Configuration
requirement.description:
DescriptionAs a customer,
I want to apply promotional and loyalty benefits,
so that eligible discounts and rewards can be considered during flight search.
DetailsCustomer shall be able to enter a promo code.

Promo code validation shall occur during search.

Valid promo codes shall be applied to pricing and availability.

Invalid promo codes shall display appropriate error messages.

Loyalty redemption search shall be supported.

Additional RequirementsLoyalty booking mode and fare booking mode shall follow separate pricing rules.

Loyalty calendar experience shall not expose revenue fare information.

User StoriesStory 1As a customer, when I have a promotional code, I want the code validated during flight search so that applicable discounts are applied.
Story 2As a loyalty member, I want to search for reward flights so that I can redeem my loyalty points.
ContextFlight search must support multiple pricing models including cash bookings, promotional fares, and loyalty redemption bookings.
Acceptance CriteriaPromo code field must be available.

Promo code validation must occur during search execution.

Invalid promo codes must display validation messages.

Valid promo codes must impact search pricing.

Loyalty search mode must be supported.

Calendar fare amounts must not be displayed when loyalty search is enabled.

Loyalty availability must remain visible.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Promo code field must be available. Promo code validation must occur during search execution. Invalid promo codes must display validation messages. Valid promo codes must impact search pricing. Loyalty search mode must be supported. Calendar fare amounts must not be displayed when loyalty search is enabled. Loyalty availability must remain visible.

AIT-7.summary: Travel Dates, Flexible Search & Multi-City Configuration

requirement.title: Travel Dates, Flexible Search & Multi-City Configuration
requirement.description:
DescriptionAs a customer,
I want to configure travel dates and journey segments,
so that the system can return accurate flight availability for my itinerary.
DetailsCustomer shall be able to select:
Departure Date

Return Date

Flexible Date Search

Calendar shall display multiple months simultaneously.

Past dates shall remain disabled.

System shall support:
Round Trip

One Way

Multi-City

Open-Jaw itineraries

Multi-City bookings shall support up to 6 flight segments.

Each Multi-City segment shall contain:
Origin

Destination

Travel Date

Open-Jaw itineraries shall be allowed.

Additional RequirementsCalendar shall support forward month navigation.

Selected dates shall be highlighted.

Flexible date search shall return nearby travel options when available.

Multi-City dates shall follow chronological sequence.

User StoriesStory 1As a customer, while planning travel, I want to select departure and return dates so that I can search available flights for my journey.
Story 2As a customer, when planning complex travel, I want to create multi-city and open-jaw itineraries so that I can fly across multiple destinations in one booking.
ContextCustomers frequently travel beyond simple round-trip journeys. The booking experience must support flexible routing and multiple destinations while enforcing airline booking rules.
Acceptance CriteriaPast dates must remain disabled.

Round Trip must require Departure and Return Dates.

Return Date must be later than Departure Date.

One-Way search must require only Departure Date.

Multi-City search must support a maximum of 6 flight segments.

Open-Jaw itineraries must be supported.

Multi-City segment dates must remain chronological.

Flexible Date Search functionality must be supported.

Multi-City segment dates must remain chronological. Flexible Date Search functionality must be supported.
